output.summary: A deciduous shrub or tree native to East and Southeast Asia. Its rough, toothed leaves can be lobed or unlobed even on the same plant, while its inner bark is traditionally made into barkcloth and paper. The fruit and cooked leaves are edible.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit and cooked leaves are edible; the species has long been cultivated for food in Asia and some Pacific islands.
